name: sleepwalk
description: Keeps a Claude Code session working with the MacBook lid shut, then turns sleep back on when the work ends.

timeLimitMinutes.title: Time limit (minutes)
timeLimitMinutes.description: Sleep comes back on after this many minutes at the latest, from 5 to 720.

batteryFloor.title: Battery floor (per cent)
batteryFloor.description: On battery power, sleep comes back on when the charge falls under this, from 5 to 95.
